purpose: Fixed input-only control for architecture versus data effects in the context encoding lesson
already_inspected: The earlier height and constant-ancilla outcomes motivate this probe. No matrices, states or order outcomes from this diagnostic were inspected before freezing it. This is an expected symmetry/design diagnostic, not independent algorithm discovery.
observation_unit: Ontario province-year inputs; no outcomes used
preprocessing: Read only year and four climate columns. Median impute and StandardScaler on all 31 training rows; global training-input geometry, not cross-validation or a predictive recipe. Permute after preprocessing.

map.states: Exact Qiskit Statevector; no sampler or compute-uncompute job

controls: Classical RBF on standardized inputs; gamma is inverse median positive squared pair distance and is held fixed under permutations
Full graph is invariant under input/qubit relabelling; linear reversal is a graph automorphism
Saved statevector relabelling using Qiskit little-endian basis indices must match these symmetries
Other linear permutations can change graph edges; no ordering is ranked or promoted
metrics: Maximum entry change from same-graph/scale identity order
Relative Frobenius change, off-diagonal mean, effective rank and minimum eigenvalue
State relabelling residual and classical RBF invariance
Untranspiled gate counts; not routed hardware cost
collection: Recompute from saved raw inputs, states and matrices without Qiskit calls or new preprocessing/model fits. Collection code is frozen with the plan.
interpretation: Known graph-symmetry and feature-order checks on reused training inputs. No labels or 2019–2024 inputs, prediction scores, optimal-order selection, noise mitigation, hardware, novel algorithm, architectural breakthrough or quantum-advantage claim. Preserve the submitted annual models/results and all prior namespaces.
